notable_absence.finding: This page lists 31 built-in wordlists (4 article lists plus 27 language stop-word lists) but, like the tokenizer and token-filter reference pages, states no default wordlist and no default token filter that uses one - the wordlist mechanism is entirely opt-in per the page's own text ('Use wordlists with token filters to choose what input...becomes a token').
